title: Greentech wins top IFSCC award for breakthrough in neuro-pigmentation
summary: Greentech has received the 2026 IFSCC Grand Prize for Applied Research at the 36th International Federation of Societies of Cosmetic Chemists (IFSCC) Congress, held in Perth, Australia, for research highlighting the role of neuronal signaling in age-related hyperpigmentation. The IFSCC jury recognized a major breakthrough in understanding how skin ages and develops pigmentation. title: Schwan Cosmetics taps Korean beauty innovation with new Seoul hub
summary: The Germany-headquartered manufacturer of white-label color cosmetics and supplier to many of the world's most recognized beauty brands is set to open its North Asia Innovation Hub in Seoul, South Korea, in January 2027. According to Schwan Cosmetics, the new R&D site will connect Korea's advances in skincare, active ingredients, and longevity with the group's formulation expertise and global production network.
